stop_reason: No exercise contrast: the study manipulates disuse only (hindlimb suspension 7/14 d vs vivarium control); there is no exercise, training or reloading arm, so the requested exercise effect is not identifiable. Independently, each unloading group is a single pooled isolation of 8 animals (S2.2.p4), so rep1/rep2 are culture replicates and the unloading effect is aliased with the isolation/expansion batch (one biological unit per group, n=2 per group x differentiation cell).
